exact_statement: Estimate n_k, the smallest integer n>2k such that the product (n-1)(n-2)...(n-k) has no prime factor p with k<p<2k.
scope_notes: For each prime p with k<p<2k the forbidden residues are exactly n mod p in {1,...,k}; the allowed set has p-k residues.
The exact periodic density product_{k<p<2k}(1-k/p) is not by itself an upper bound for the first allowed representative.
The June 2026 van Doorn--Tang theorem n_k>exp((log k)^2/(20 log log k)) is inherited literature, not a result of this campaign.
Finite values, average-over-shift non-emptiness, and heuristic Poisson laws do not estimate n_k for all sufficiently large k.
